purpose: Audit city-scoped land/cadastre evidence separately from accessible public parcel geometry; record only executed searches and actual page/request outcomes.
name: Porto-Novo
pointBasis: Chosen approximate central-city query point; not a WUP centroid or official boundary.
jurisdiction: Benin national cadastre; ANDF and the e-Foncier national platform cover pilot communes including Porto-Novo.
registryBasis: ANDF’s official 2 December 2024 notice names Porto-Novo as one of 12 communes whose land-formalization records were integrated into the e-Foncier cadastral database from January 2025. ANDF/TERRA reporting also identifies Porto-Novo among pilot communes. This is city-specific coverage evidence, separately confirmed by the bounded public WFS sample.
findings: A bounded public WFS GetFeature request by the parent/root agent returned three closed Polygon features around the Porto-Novo locator. All three are attributed to commune PORTO-NOVO. The bounded request matched 304 records and returned 3 (1,799-byte response). A separate local curl attempt in this subagent could not resolve the host; that local DNS failure did not imply endpoint unavailability. The sample proves geometry at this small locator window only, not complete city coverage.
